description: Pump exact-in buys on Solana mainnet-beta (program 6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P): the instruction data and the TradeEvent payload of each, retained byte-for-byte from finalized transactions.

source.selection: Every second successful signature from finalized getSignaturesForAddress(6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P) pages; kept when the transaction holds exactly one pump trade instruction (outer or inner) and it is buy_exact_sol_in or buy_exact_quote_in_v3, and exactly one TradeEvent.
source.field: instruction is the base64 of that instruction's data (8-byte discriminator, then spendable input u64 at offset 8); data is the base64 text after 'Program data: ' in meta.logMessages.
